description: Voting + live results. Per-option counts, visible percentages and own-vote flag, single or multi-choice, optional closed (results-only) state. Presentational (reaction-bar pattern): emits poll-wc:vote, marks the option data-pending until the author calls setCount after the server confirms. Can enhance a native <form><fieldset> of radios/checkboxes as a no-JS fallback.

attributes.name: aria-label
attributes.description: Group label when there is no question slot; moved onto the option group (the host has no role)

attributes.name: data-hide-counts
attributes.description: Hide per-option counts, percentages and bars, visually and from assistive tech

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Disable voting; observed, so toggling it updates aria-disabled immediately

attributes.name: data-label-votes
attributes.description: Count noun for other plural categories

attributes.name: data-label-your-choice
attributes.description: Appended to the accessible name of the user's own option

attributes.name: data-label-closed
attributes.description: Appended to the total when data-closed is set

attributes.name: data-label-poll
attributes.description: Fallback group name with no question and no aria-label

events.name: poll-wc:vote
events.description: Single-choice: switching options emits a remove for the previously-selected option BEFORE the add.

properties.name: setCount
properties.description: Update a single option after the server confirms (or roll back on failure); clears data-pending

properties.name: setCounts
properties.description: Bulk-update counts; opts.mine accepts a string or string[]; clears every data-pending

childAttributes.name: data-mine
childAttributes.description: Current user voted for this option

childAttributes.name: data-pending
childAttributes.description: Output: a vote for this option is in flight; further clicks are ignored until setCount/setCounts
